'''Vakkar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Vakkar system/Legends|Vakkar system]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].

==History==
Vakkar joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] prior to the [[Indecta Era]]. During the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], it supported [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> The planet was the Imperial [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]].<ref name="Godking" />
